summary: Steep, narrow Jainba Street with houses 7-11 m from the kerb.
reasons: No obvious room to pull off

best_section.where: Mid-block on Jainba Street, north side, between the two cross streets

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 9 m (at 30 m) and 7 m (at 61 m) from the kerb; houses all along the side.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed lane in dense vegetation; little clear ground beside the lane, and steep.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street with few cars.
drivers.convention: Only a couple of cars parked near the top end; no parking convention along the steep section.

flags: Steep: mean grade 11.8%, about 9% at best section
Dwellings within 10 m of the section
Powerlines run along the north side
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy over most of the section, mainly from the north side.
